SEO Mistakes Small Businesses Should Avoid

Many small businesses make errors that hurt their search rankings. We highlight the most common SEO mistakes and explain how to avoid or resolve them.

Mistake 1: Keyword Stuffing and Near-Duplicate Content

Repeating target terms too often or creating duplicate location pages hurts readability and rankings. Write naturally, and build unique, helpful pages for each service and city.

Mistake 2: Missing Canonical Tags and Broken Paths

Duplicate URLs confuse search engines. Implement clean canonical tags on every page and fix crawl issues and broken links to maintain search authority.

Mistake 3: Thin Content Pages with No Helpfulness

Creating short pages merely to target search terms provides no value to visitors. Ensure every service and location page has unique introductions, details, and FAQs that satisfy search intent.
